title: Austin Day Spa Onboard Yacht Charter
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Do you need a day of rest, relaxation and self care – a day for you? Constant pressure from an always-connected life at work and at home eventually leads to disengagement and burnout. Pamper yourself and find your Zen with your friends, family or group and book a Blue Mind day spa experience aboard the Fathom Freedom yacht. Escape and unwind with our own amazing version of paradise where we create a sanctuary of relaxation and tranquility. Choose from a mani/pedi, massage, gentle yoga or a guided meditation led by our instructor. Outings include healthy foods, fresh fruit-infused beverages, wholesome snacks and a complementary glass of mimosa, champagne or prosecco.

The Fathom Blue Mind experience is held onboard Fathom Freedom, a sleek, modern 38-foot yacht located on Lake Travis. This is a great option to consider for yourself, friends, family, or a team.
